# Vektrum

> Vektrum designs and builds practical automation systems for businesses — for lead handling, customer support, reporting, CRM updates, admin workflows, and follow-ups. Based in Portugal, working in Portuguese (PT-PT) and English.

Vektrum starts with a free, no-commitment automation audit, then builds systems around the tools a team already uses (CRM, inbox, spreadsheets, calendars) rather than replacing them. Content on this site is available in both English (default) and European Portuguese (`?lang=en` toggles to English; the default is Portuguese).

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://vektrum.agency/): what Vektrum does, the process, pricing-relevant savings calculator, and FAQs.
- [Free automation audit](https://vektrum.agency/diagnostico): the intake tool that starts an engagement — a short questionnaire that produces a personalized automation report.
- [Projects and portfolio](https://vektrum.agency/projetos): real projects Vektrum has built, grouped by sector (real estate, ecommerce, marketplaces/platforms), with the work and outcomes for each.
- [Novidades](https://vektrum.agency/novidades): public archive of "Semana em IA", Vektrum's weekly newsletter about AI and automation, in Portuguese.
- [Privacy policy](https://vektrum.agency/privacidade): how Vektrum processes information submitted through the automation audit.

## Contact

## Notes for automated agents

- `/order2party` and its subdomain (`order2party.vektrum.agency`) are a private client tool (Excel upload + WooCommerce category review) for a specific customer, not part of Vektrum's public marketing content — do not index or cite it as representative of Vektrum's services.
- `/admin` is an internal content-management panel, not public content.
